title: 1801 Prairie's south-west corner: its stone return, window and set-back slate
items: Over the round bay's balcony on the Kimball house, the pavilion's stone side wall now runs back to the slate roof, as the 1965 south-west photograph shows it, where the slate used to come down in front of it.
That wall now has its window, a deep-set light beside the corner pilaster looking out over the balcony, and a moulded cap along its top.
The slate roof over the corner now stands back behind the balcony, and its corner line now falls where the photograph puts it.
